title: Payment API database timeout
symptoms: Payment requests became slow, API latency exceeded 4 seconds, and PostgreSQL connection timeouts increased after a deployment.
root_cause: The PostgreSQL connection pool was exhausted after worker concurrency was increased.
solution: Reduced worker concurrency and increased the database connection pool capacity.
notes: Add pool-utilization alerting and a deployment configuration check.

title: Checkout Redis memory exhaustion
symptoms: Checkout requests intermittently failed and Redis reported out-of-memory errors.
root_cause: A cache key retention bug caused stale checkout-session keys to accumulate until Redis reached its memory limit.
solution: Fixed the expiration logic, removed stale keys, and increased temporary Redis memory headroom.

title: Authentication token verification latency
symptoms: Login requests slowed down and token verification latency increased during peak traffic.
root_cause: The service repeatedly fetched signing keys because the local key cache was disabled by a configuration change.
solution: Restored signing-key caching and corrected the production configuration.

title: PostgreSQL CPU overload during report generation
symptoms: Database CPU reached 95 percent and report requests timed out during a large scheduled reporting job.
root_cause: An unbounded reporting query performed a full scan over a large event table.
solution: Added the missing index, limited the report date range, and moved the scheduled job outside peak traffic.
notes: Useful as a deliberately similar-but-different database timeout incident for retrieval testing.

title: Notification provider rate-limit failures
symptoms: Email delivery failed in bursts and the external provider returned HTTP 429 responses.
root_cause: A retry configuration caused synchronized retries that exceeded the provider rate limit.
solution: Added exponential backoff with jitter and reduced retry concurrency.
notes: This incident provides a non-database example for later semantic-search evaluation.
